body_text: Children learn through movement. Songs, rhymes and dance build rhythm, coordination, body awareness and confidence.

image.alt: Girl dancing joyfully with her arms raised

title: Sing & Rhyme
text: Songs and rhymes help children listen, join in and find new words.
text_2: Movement shows what children feel and imagine, even before they have the words.
text_3: Climbing, balancing and jumping build strong bodies and coordination.
